title: apistore.Storage has no `codec` field anymore; use `serializer`
answers: Why does my code/test fail to compile referencing Storage.codec?
Where did apistore.Storage's codec field go?
How do tests decode objects stored by apistore.Storage now?
body: `Storage.codec runtime.Codec` was replaced by `Storage.serializer Serializer` (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/store.go: `Storage`). `objectForStorage.raw` is now `json.RawMessage` instead of `bytes.Buffer`, so test/decoding code must call `s.serializer.Decode(ctx, v.raw, obj)` instead of `s.codec.Decode(v.raw.Bytes(), nil, obj)`. Any Storage literal built directly in tests (not via `NewStorage`) must set `serializer` (e.g. `&jsonSerializer{}`) or decoding/encoding will panic on a nil interface.
applies: Tests or code that construct pkg/storage/unified/apistore.Storage directly or decode its stored bytes.
